exposure: perceived threat to one's own life during childbirth
perceived threat to infant's life during childbirth
cohort: 72 mothers from a community sample and 75 mothers after emergency cesarean section.
finding: Both perceived maternal and infant life threat during childbirth were prospectively but differentially associated with maternal CB-PTSS and probable CB-PTSD at 4-6 weeks and 6 months postpartum.
